verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly claims real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries (ramp-docs-5). It also documents auto-categorized transactions syncing directly to the ERP (ramp-docs-15), a broad accounting integration directory covering NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QBO, Xero, Workday and others (ramp-intdir-1), and a syncable-transactions endpoint for accounting providers (ramp-supp-banking-api). The evidence is mostly one-line marketing claims rather than detailed integration docs. missing for 10: technical documentation of the bidirectional mechanics (what flows back from the ERP, sync latency, conflict handling), per-ERP depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time sync.
